mathematical_audit.adaptive_cutoff: Because C_(p,Y) contains every prime at most Y except p, saturation preserves gcd(p,J) and leaves only p or primes greater than Y. Radicals therefore factor exactly as L^[Y]=j_tie F^[Y].
mathematical_audit.margin_invariance: For Y2>=Y1>=p, the primes removed between the cutoffs are all foreign and divide the old L and F once each. Hence log L-log F, and therefore J_e=D_e-G_e, is invariant row by row and after summation.
mathematical_audit.selected_prime_cutoff: Taking Y=p removes every factor 2r+3
mathematical_audit.aligned_transport: If q>p divides the remaining foreign carrier and q congruent 2r+3 mod 6, then t=(q-2r-3)/6 is a positive integer, M_q=(r+7q)/6 is integral, and M_q-M=7(q-p)/6>0. This is the unique future same-r ordinary-j2 row and q divides its degenerate gate.
mathematical_audit.transport_limit: The source condition q not dividing Gamma_(r,s) does not control Gamma_(r,t). Item409's target replacement is tied-characteristic-specific, so the theorem transports only gate status, not future collision or rejection status.
mathematical_audit.height_screen: There are O(M/log M) prime rows in a fixed-proportion interval and each log J is O(M log M), giving only B^[p]=O(M^2). Since all foreign primes exceed p comparable to M, the total factor incidence is O(M^2/log M). Neither estimate is linear.
mathematical_audit.information_class_boundary: The abstract squarefree carriers show that pointwise height, row count, and q>p support alone allow Theta(M^2) mass. They are explicitly not actual values and do not exclude formula-specific arithmetic or weighted average theorems.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The valid conditional saving is max(0,a-b,1/35-g-n)/6. No proved constants satisfy a>b or g+n<1/35, so the ordinary-j2 ceiling remains 1/105.
